description:
## Goal

Give the compiler's spreadsheet-style fact engine one generic way to know that a cyclic set of reactive cells is quiescent. This is the only missing infrastructure needed for recursive demand cells to publish monotone current values while downstream artifact cells consume only a coherent settled epoch.

## Output contract

- A formula evaluates initially or because at least one recorded dependency revision moved since its previous evaluation.
- A formula whose output is unchanged wakes no readers.
- Cells inside a recursive group may read one another's current monotone values without waiting and deadlocking.
- A downstream settled read is satisfied only when every formula in the exact dynamic dependency group has observed current inputs and no newly discovered edge remains unevaluated.
- A cell or topology change reopens the group epoch without clearing any standing lattice value.
- Dynamic group growth/merge is represented by the same dependency graph; there is no subsystem-owned group inventory.
- Acyclic cells pay no cyclic-group machinery beyond their ordinary fact dependencies.

The epoch is stability state, not a scheduling pass. No root scan, phase order, leaf seeding, cone collection, replay, or bottom reset is permitted.

## Correct altitude

Implement this in the generic fact/scheduler layer. Runtime demand is the first consumer, not the owner and not a special case. The primitive must be expressible and testable with a tiny synthetic lattice independent of compiler semantics.

This supersedes the separate provisional-publication abstraction from fz-kdt.42. One consistency concept is enough: current monotone cell values plus a generic quiescent epoch for consumers that require finality.

## Telemetry proof

Production telemetry must make these invariants decidable:

- cell evaluations, classified as initial or by the dependency revisions that moved;
- output changes versus unchanged evaluations;
- downstream wakes caused by each changed output;
- group epoch opened/settled/reopened and membership/edge growth;
- cell resets/replays (required to remain zero);
- whole-fact-table scans (required to remain zero).

A test must assert that every non-initial evaluation has new input evidence, unchanged output causes zero downstream wakes, and adding an edge evaluates only its affected frontier.

## Checks

- Generic acyclic chain: one change walks only its downstream closure.
- Generic cycle: current values ascend to a fixed point without a pass or provisional leakage.
- Dynamic edge added mid-ascent: prior values stand; only the new frontier evaluates; the epoch settles once.
- Removing or replacing upstream ground reopens the epoch and reaches the correct new fixed point.
- Existing scheduler/fact tests remain green.
- Agent documentation states the cell and quiescence invariants.

## Removal obligation

This primitive is justified only by the deletion in fz-kdt.4. Do not add a demand-specific adapter, secondary cache, or permanent scaffold.
title: Fact engine: cyclic reactive cells settle through one quiescent epoch
